Guidance on suicide and other self-destructive activities, including

app.auto_inaccurate_information_threate: Inaccurate information threatens physical safety, such as false warnings about disasters or misinformation about ongoing violent incidents.
app.auto_content_is_harassing_provocati: Content is harassing, provocative, and discriminatory

app.auto_of_course_context_plays_an_imp: Of course, context plays an important role. We consider many factors when evaluating the results that the application produces, including the intended use for education, documentaries, art, or science.
app.auto_ensuring_that_gemini_complies: Ensuring that Gemini complies with these principles is a challenge: Users can interact with Gemini in countless ways, and Gemini can respond in numerous ways as well. This is because LLMs (large language models) are probabilistic, meaning they always produce new and different responses to user inputs. Additionally, Gemini generates results based on its training data, so it can sometimes reflect the limitations of that data. These are prominent issues for large language models, and although we continually strive to mitigate these challenges, Gemini may sometimes produce content that violates our principles, shows biased viewpoints, or contains sweeping conclusions, especially when responding to difficult prompts.
